title: Tips on saving energy
paragraphs: We all want to save money, and with the cost of living on the rise in the UK, it’s become more important than ever to watch what we spend. The biggest increase in our expenditure at the moment is on energy – the oil, gas and electricity we use to power and heat our homes. That’s why many of us are looking at ways to save energy so we don’t have to shell out on huge fuel bills.

Making our home more energy efficient is the obvious way to save money. To try to achieve this, new homes in the UK will be banned from installing new gas and oil boilers by 2025. Having a heat pump instead can help save energy, but they’re unaffordable for many people, unless they’ve got spare cash stashed away.

If your home feels like a money pit, there are some low-budget solutions you can turn to to lower your energy usage. Warm air escapes our homes easily, so adding draught excluders or a rolled-up towel to block these gaps will help. Investing in new double glazing will certainly insulate your home better, but if it is too costly, it might be worth using some heavy curtains to stop the heat escaping. Switching off lights is also a good idea.

But there are lots of other little things we can do around the home that will help save energy, don’t cost a fortune and that just require tweaks to our behaviour. They could be as good as installing, fitting or making anything. Put lids on pots and pans when cooking – the food will be ready quicker. Use a microwave to reheat food rather than the oven. Don’t overfill your kettle when boiling water, and don’t leave electrical items on standby. Jo Patterson from Cardiff University’s Welsh School of Architecture told the BBC that a combination of small measures like these could reduce household energy bills by about 10%.
So, we’re being encouraged to be more fuel efficient. But our main aim isn’t just financial – we need to do it to reduce our carbon footprint, so that our energy usage doesn’t cost the Earth.

vocabulary.entry: cost of living /ˌkɒst ɒv ˈlɪvɪŋ/ n. 生活成本
vocabulary.example: The cost of living in the capital has risen by 5% this year.
vocabulary.translation: 首都的生活成本今年上涨了5%。

vocabulary.entry: watch what we spend /wɒtʃ wɒt wi spend/ 精打细算；留意日常开支
vocabulary.example: We have to watch what we spend now that prices are going up everywhere.
vocabulary.translation: 现在各处物价都在涨，我们必须精打细算。

vocabulary.entry: expenditure /ɪkˈspendɪtʃə(r)/ n. 开支；消费；支出
vocabulary.example: We need to cut down on non-essential expenditure.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要削减非必要开支。

vocabulary.entry: shell out /ʃel aʊt/ （口语）掏钱；花大笔钱
vocabulary.example: I had to shell out over £500 to get my car fixed.
vocabulary.translation: 我不得不花500多英镑修我的车。

vocabulary.entry: fuel bill /ˈfjuːəl bɪl/ n. 能源账单；燃料费用单
vocabulary.example: Our fuel bill has doubled since last winter.
vocabulary.translation: 自去年冬天以来，我们的能源账单翻了一倍。

vocabulary.entry: energy efficient /ˌenədʒi ɪˈfɪʃnt/ adj. 节能的；能源效率高的
vocabulary.example: These fridges are more energy efficient than the older models.
vocabulary.translation: 这些冰箱比老款更节能。

vocabulary.entry: gas and oil boiler /ˌɡæs ənd ɔɪl ˈbɔɪlə(r)/ n. 燃气燃油锅炉
vocabulary.example: We’re replacing our old gas and oil boiler with a more eco-friendly system.
vocabulary.translation: 我们正把老式的燃气燃油锅炉换成更环保的系统。

vocabulary.entry: heat pump /hiːt pʌmp/ n. 热泵
vocabulary.example: A heat pump can both heat and cool a home efficiently.
vocabulary.translation: 热泵能高效地为房屋供暖和制冷。

vocabulary.entry: unaffordable /ˌʌnəˈfɔːdəbl/ adj. 买不起的；负担不起的
vocabulary.example: Housing has become unaffordable for most young people in the city.
vocabulary.translation: 这座城市的住房对大多数年轻人来说已经买不起了。

vocabulary.entry: spare cash /speə kæʃ/ n. 闲钱；备用现金
vocabulary.example: I don’t have any spare cash for a holiday this year.
vocabulary.translation: 今年我没有闲钱去度假。

vocabulary.entry: stash away /stæʃ əˈweɪ/ 储存；藏匿（钱财、物品）
vocabulary.example: She stashes away a small amount of money every month for emergencies.
vocabulary.translation: 她每个月都存一点钱以备不时之需。

vocabulary.entry: money pit /ˈmʌni pɪt/ n. （口语）烧钱的地方；持续耗费钱财的事物
vocabulary.example: This old house is a real money pit—we’re always paying for repairs.
vocabulary.translation: 这栋老房子就是个烧钱的坑，我们总在花钱修。

vocabulary.entry: low-budget /ˌləʊ ˈbʌdʒɪt/ adj. 低成本的；预算紧张的
vocabulary.example: We came up with a low-budget solution to the problem.
vocabulary.translation: 我们想出了一个低成本的办法来解决这个问题。

vocabulary.entry: energy usage /ˈenədʒi ˈjuːsɪdʒ/ n. 能源消耗；用能情况
vocabulary.example: The app tracks your home’s energy usage in real time.
vocabulary.translation: 这个应用会实时追踪你家的能源消耗情况。

vocabulary.entry: draught excluder /ˈdrɑːft ɪkskluːdə(r)/ n. 防风条；门底密封条
vocabulary.example: A draught excluder on the front door will keep the cold out.
vocabulary.translation: 前门装个防风条就能挡住冷空气。

vocabulary.entry: block the gaps /blɒk ðə ɡæps/ 堵住缝隙；封堵缺口
vocabulary.example: Use foam to block the gaps around the windows to save heat.
vocabulary.translation: 用泡沫堵住窗户周围的缝隙来保温。

vocabulary.entry: invest in /ɪnˈvest ɪn/ 购置；投资（物品、项目等）
vocabulary.example: We decided to invest in a new energy-efficient washing machine.
vocabulary.translation: 我们决定买一台新的节能洗衣机。

vocabulary.entry: double glazing /ˌdʌbl ˈɡleɪzɪŋ/ n. 双层玻璃
vocabulary.example: Installing double glazing made the house much quieter and warmer.
vocabulary.translation: 安装双层玻璃后，房子变得安静又暖和多了。

vocabulary.entry: insulate /ˈɪnsjuleɪt/ v. 使隔热；使保温；使绝缘
vocabulary.example: We need to insulate the walls to reduce heat loss.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要给墙壁做保温处理来减少热量流失。

vocabulary.entry: cost a fortune /kɒst ə ˈfɔːtʃuːn/ （口语）花大价钱；耗资巨大
vocabulary.example: Renovating the whole house would cost a fortune.
vocabulary.translation: 翻新整栋房子会花一大笔钱。

vocabulary.entry: tweak /twiːk/ n. 微小调整；小幅改动
vocabulary.example: Just a few small tweaks to the plan will make it perfect.
vocabulary.translation: 对计划做几处小调整就会使其变得完美。

vocabulary.entry: reheat /ˌriːˈhiːt/ v. 重新加热；把……热一下
vocabulary.example: Use the microwave to reheat the soup for one minute.
vocabulary.translation: 用微波炉把汤加热一分钟。

vocabulary.entry: overfill /ˌəʊvəˈfɪl/ v. 装得太满；过量填充
vocabulary.example: Don’t overfill the cup or the coffee will spill.
vocabulary.translation: 杯子别装太满，不然咖啡会洒出来。

vocabulary.entry: electrical item /ɪˈlektrɪkl ˈaɪtəm/ n. 电器；电气用品
vocabulary.example: Unplug all electrical items when you go on holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 度假时把所有电器的插头都拔掉。

vocabulary.entry: on standby /ɒn ˈstændbaɪ/ （电器）处于待机状态；待命
vocabulary.example: Leaving the TV on standby still uses electricity.
vocabulary.translation: 电视开着待机模式也会耗电。

vocabulary.entry: combination /ˌkɒmbɪˈneɪʃn/ n. 结合；组合；联用
vocabulary.example: A combination of diet and exercise is the best way to lose weight.
vocabulary.translation: 饮食和运动相结合是减肥的最佳方式。

vocabulary.entry: small measures /ˈsmɔːl ˈmeʒəz/ n. 小举措；小方法
vocabulary.example: These small measures will help to reduce water waste.
vocabulary.translation: 这些小举措有助于减少水资源浪费。

vocabulary.entry: household energy bill /ˈhaʊshəʊld ˈenədʒi bɪl/ n. 家庭能源账单
vocabulary.example: We were pleased to see our household energy bill go down.
vocabulary.translation: 看到家庭能源账单金额下降，我们很开心。

vocabulary.entry: fuel efficient /ˌfjuːəl ɪˈfɪʃnt/ adj. 节能的；燃料效率高的
vocabulary.example: This new car is very fuel efficient and uses less petrol.
vocabulary.translation: 这款新车非常省油，耗油量更低。

vocabulary.entry: carbon footprint /ˈkɑːbən ˈfʊtprɪnt/ n. 碳足迹
vocabulary.example: We can reduce our carbon footprint by using public transport more.
vocabulary.translation: 我们可以通过多乘坐公共交通来减少碳足迹。

vocabulary.entry: cost the Earth /kɒst ði ɜːθ/ （口语）耗资巨大；付出巨大代价
vocabulary.example: This piece of jewelry cost the Earth.
vocabulary.translation: 这件珠宝贵得离谱。

sentences.english: We all want to save money, and with the cost of living on the rise in the UK, it’s become more important than ever to watch what we spend.
sentences.chinese: 我们都想省钱，而随着英国生活成本不断上涨，精打细算变得比以往任何时候都更加重要。

sentences.english: The biggest increase in our expenditure at the moment is on energy – the oil, gas and electricity we use to power and heat our homes.
sentences.chinese: 目前我们开销中增长最明显的部分是能源开支——也就是用于家庭供电和供暖的燃油、燃气以及电费。

sentences.english: That’s why many of us are looking at ways to save energy so we don’t have to shell out on huge fuel bills.
sentences.chinese: 这也是为什么许多人都在寻找节能方法，避免为高昂的能源账单买单。

sentences.english: Making our home more energy efficient is the obvious way to save money.
sentences.chinese: 显而易见，让我们的家更节能是省钱的有效途径。

sentences.english: To try to achieve this, new homes in the UK will be banned from installing new gas and oil boilers by 2025.
sentences.chinese: 为了实现这一目标，英国将从2025年起禁止新建住宅安装燃气和燃油锅炉。

sentences.english: Having a heat pump instead can help save energy, but they’re unaffordable for many people, unless they’ve got spare cash stashed away.
sentences.chinese: 改用热泵有助于节能，但对很多人来说，除非手头有闲钱储蓄，否则热泵的价格实在难以负担。

sentences.english: If your home feels like a money pit, there are some low-budget solutions you can turn to to lower your energy usage.
sentences.chinese: 如果感觉你的家一直在“烧钱”，有一些低成本的方法可以降低能源消耗。

sentences.english: Warm air escapes our homes easily, so adding draught excluders or a rolled-up towel to block these gaps will help.
sentences.chinese: 室内的暖气很容易从缝隙流失，因此安装防风条，或是用卷起来的毛巾堵住这些缝隙，都会有帮助。

sentences.english: Investing in new double glazing will certainly insulate your home better, but if it is too costly, it might be worth using some heavy curtains to stop the heat escaping.
sentences.chinese: 安装新的双层玻璃窗固然能更好地为房屋保温，但如果成本过高，挂厚窗帘来阻止热量散失也是个不错的选择。

sentences.english: Switching off lights is also a good idea.
sentences.chinese: 随手关灯同样是个好习惯。

sentences.english: But there are lots of other little things we can do around the home that will help save energy, don’t cost a fortune and that just require tweaks to our behaviour. They could be as good as installing, fitting or making anything.
sentences.chinese: 不过，我们还可以在家中做很多其他小事来节能，这些方法不仅成本低廉，而且只需要稍微调整一下日常习惯，效果不亚于安装任何节能设备。

sentences.english: Put lids on pots and pans when cooking – the food will be ready quicker. Use a microwave to reheat food rather than the oven. Don’t overfill your kettle when boiling water, and don’t leave electrical items on standby.
sentences.chinese: 做饭时给锅碗瓢盆盖上盖子，食物会熟得更快；用微波炉加热剩菜，而不是用烤箱；烧开水时不要把水壶装得太满；不用电器时别让它们处于待机状态。

sentences.english: Jo Patterson from Cardiff University’s Welsh School of Architecture told the BBC that a combination of small measures like these could reduce household energy bills by about 10%.
sentences.chinese: 卡迪夫大学威尔士建筑学院的乔·帕特森在接受BBC采访时表示，将这些小举措结合起来，大约能为家庭减少10%的能源账单支出。

sentences.english: So, we’re being encouraged to be more fuel efficient.
sentences.chinese: 因此，人们被鼓励提高能源利用效率。

sentences.english: But our main aim isn’t just financial – we need to do it to reduce our carbon footprint, so that our energy usage doesn’t cost the Earth.
sentences.chinese: 但我们的主要目的不只是省钱——我们这么做是为了减少碳足迹，让能源消耗不再以牺牲地球为代价。
